items.quote: Waiting for Certainty? Most people wait for certainty before they act. But here’s something I’ve learned firsthand—you'll never be certain of anything until you act.
items.statement: Most people wait for certainty before they act.

items.quote: I remember when I had this vague sense of what I could be doing with my career, but I kept hesitating. I was waiting for some sign or confirmation before making the leap.
items.statement: I kept hesitating, waiting for some sign or confirmation before making the leap.

items.quote: Be willing to risk—your image, your time, your effort, your comfort, and yes, even failure.
items.statement: Be willing to risk your image, time, effort, comfort, and even failure.

items.quote: In this picture, I'm with one of my students who recognized me during her onboarding at her new company. She had been following me on LinkedIn for a while and shared how my content had inspired her.
items.statement: One of my students recognized me during her onboarding and shared how my content had inspired her.

items.quote: Clarity only ever comes through action.
items.statement: Clarity only ever comes through action.

overview: LinkedIn post discussing the importance of action over waiting for certainty in personal and professional growth.
